February 13, 1984

OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT

( N 4C )

03675007

Lorillard

…

To: The Executive Committee

From: Curt Judge

You all have received the agenda for the meeting of The National Tobacco Council in Phoenix on February 24th.

You will note that, as your Chairman, I've been designated to talk for 6-10 minutes on "Problems Unique to the Manufacturing Segment of the Industry."
Since I represent you, I would appreciate receiving by Thursday, February 16th, any suggestions you have concerning the content of my comments.

Thank you and regards.

Sincerely,

[SIGNATURE] fact

Curtis H. Judge, Chairman
TI - Executive Committee
